hooks.command: [ "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Direct edits to main are blocked. Create a feature branch first."}' >&2; exit 2; }

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'pkg/(signals|fusion)/'; then if grep -qE 'k8s\.io|sigs\.k8s\.io' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "pkg/signals and pkg/fusion must have zero Kubernetes dependencies."}' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.go$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'api/v1alpha1/.*\.go$'; then echo '{"feedback": "types.go changed — remember to run: make generate && make manifests"}' >&2; fi
